## The problem

There is ever-increasing demand for more presentations.

Interesting things to say are the foundation -- ideally -- of all these presentations --- but while there are

::: {.incremental}
- tools for creating presentation slides
- interesting things to present in them
:::

. . .

they are not connected together.

. . .

**Can we use a Quarto template to make it easier to share the interesting things?**
